chapter: Other pianists and the New Orleans scene
title: Celestin recordings of the 1920s
summary: She made three or four records with Celestin, including My Josephine and Marrero's Station Calls, issued on Columbia 78s.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: You make quite a few records in the twenties with Celestine.
Do you remember much about those recordings?
One was My Josephine. And other names that I just can't recall. John Marrera had several. And I was on those. That was when I first joined in 26, like I said.
Well, I think it was one, I forget the name of it, but he's featuring himself on the banjo. Yeah. Can I? I can't guess you'd plan on that.
Can you remember the name? Because I can't.
Station Calls. I remember that now.
Do you remember when those records came out? Did they send you a copy of those records when they came out?
I have them at my home in the Paschkechand. I have some of them. Uh-huh. They were made by Columbia, 78.
